evals.prompt: send a Paradigm RFQ for a BTC 7MAY26 90/80 risk reversal, 100 contracts, directed to LP1 and LP2, Deribit settlement
evals.expected_output: A taker RFQ-build flow that: (1) calls paradigm_drfqv2_instruments to resolve BTC-7MAY26-90000-C and BTC-7MAY26-80000-P to integer instrument_ids; (2) calls paradigm_drfqv2_counterparties (or accepts the user's LP1/LP2 as desk names) and assembles a paradigm_drfqv2_create_rfq call with venue=DBT, the two legs with ratio=1 and correct sides, quantity=100, counterparties=["LP1","LP2"], a label, and is_taker_anonymous=false; (3) pulls Deribit fair value (deribit__get_ticker or web_fetch) for each leg and shows net delta / premium reference; (4) presents a confirmation block and waits for explicit yes before invoking paradigm_drfqv2_create_rfq; (5) includes a data-source trace listing each tool called.
assertions: Response calls (or describes calling) paradigm_drfqv2_instruments to resolve BTC-7MAY26-90000-C and BTC-7MAY26-80000-P to integer instrument_ids
Response assembles a paradigm_drfqv2_create_rfq call with venue=DBT, two legs with ratio=1, correct sides (+call -put), and quantity=100
Response sets counterparties to ["LP1", "LP2"] (directed, not open)
Response includes a Deribit fair-value reference (mark price and/or IV) for each leg before invoking the create tool
Response presents a confirmation block and waits for explicit user yes before calling paradigm_drfqv2_create_rfq
Response does not echo or print PARADIGM_ACCESS_KEY or PARADIGM_SIGNING_KEY anywhere
Response includes a data-source trace listing the MCP tools called and the fair-value source

evals.prompt: quote rfq_12345 at 0.5 vol over Deribit mark, sell side, full size
evals.expected_output: A maker quoting flow that: (1) calls paradigm_drfqv2_rfq_snapshot(rfq_id="rfq_12345") to read the RFQ legs + current BBO; (2) pulls Deribit mark IV per leg, bumps IV by +0.5 vol points, reprices via Black-Scholes, aggregates to the structure price (optionally via paradigm_drfqv2_price_legs); (3) shows the computed price and implied edge versus Deribit mark; (4) presents a confirmation block with the planned paradigm_drfqv2_post_order call (side=SELL, type=LIMIT, time_in_force=GOOD_TILL_CANCELED, computed price, quantity matching RFQ); (5) waits for explicit yes before calling the tool.
assertions: Response identifies this as a maker quote flow against rfq_12345 with side=SELL
Response calls (or describes calling) paradigm_drfqv2_rfq_snapshot or equivalent to read the RFQ legs before pricing
Response applies a +0.5 vol point bump to per-leg Deribit IV and recomputes the structure price
Response presents a paradigm_drfqv2_post_order payload with time_in_force=GOOD_TILL_CANCELED, type=LIMIT, side=SELL
Response waits for explicit user confirmation before invoking paradigm_drfqv2_post_order
Response does not echo or print the signing key or access key
Response includes a data-source trace listing the fair-value source and the MCP tool called

evals.prompt: how do I install the Paradigm MCP server?
evals.expected_output: A setup guide pointing at github.com/tradeparadigm/mcp-paradigm-py with at least two install paths: (1) the .mcpb bundle from the latest GitHub release for Claude Desktop, double-click + enter access key and signing key when prompted; (2) pip install mcp-paradigm or uvx mcp-paradigm for Claude Code / generic MCP hosts, with a config JSON block showing PARADIGM_ACCESS_KEY, PARADIGM_SIGNING_KEY, and PARADIGM_ENVIRONMENT env vars. The response does not ask the user to paste keys into chat; keys go into the MCP config or the bundle prompt.
assertions: Response links to or names github.com/tradeparadigm/mcp-paradigm-py (or its PyPI name mcp-paradigm)
Response describes at least two install paths (.mcpb bundle and pip/uvx)
Response shows a config block listing PARADIGM_ACCESS_KEY, PARADIGM_SIGNING_KEY, and PARADIGM_ENVIRONMENT
Response does NOT ask the user to paste their key into chat — keys go into the MCP config or bundle prompt
Response does not echo any environment variable value back

evals.prompt: cross the top ask on rfq_12345
evals.expected_output: A taker cross flow that: (1) calls paradigm_drfqv2_rfq_snapshot to read the current order book and identify the top ask; (2) pulls Deribit fair value for benchmark; (3) presents a confirmation block with the planned paradigm_drfqv2_post_order call (side=BUY to cross an ask, type=LIMIT, time_in_force=FILL_OR_KILL, price>=ask, quantity); (4) waits for explicit yes before invoking; (5) notes the response will be PENDING (async-first) and that the skill will poll paradigm_drfqv2_orders for the terminal state plus paradigm_drfqv2_trades for the trade_id once cleared.
assertions: Response calls paradigm_drfqv2_rfq_snapshot (or paradigm_drfqv2_orders with rfq_id) to read the resting book before crossing
Response assembles a paradigm_drfqv2_post_order call with side=BUY (opposite the top ask), type=LIMIT, time_in_force=FILL_OR_KILL
Response presents a confirmation block and waits for explicit yes before invoking the order tool
Response notes the async-first behavior (response is PENDING) and that the skill will poll paradigm_drfqv2_orders for the terminal state
Response references paradigm_drfqv2_trades or trade_id for the cleared-trade surface
